gridDNA: A vertical stack of distinct content blocks: a large top section with a prominent headline, hero product illustration, and a multi-step process diagram; a middle section featuring a horizontal product array with an offer callout; and a bottom section with a three-column instructional grid.

typeScale: headline ~8% of canvas height, offer headline ~2.3%, badge text ~2%, instructional text ~1.5%, fine print ~0.8%
colourBlocking: The entire canvas is a stark white background, providing maximum contrast for black line art illustrations and text, with a single vibrant red circular badge serving as a high-impact accent color.
negativeSpace: Ample white space surrounds all major elements, particularly in the top half and between sections, allowing each visual and text block to breathe and stand out without clutter, emphasizing clarity and focus.
eyePath: Headline -> Year Supply Bundle badge -> Main Product -> Process Illustration (pour -> swish) -> Offer Headline (BUY 3, GET 5 FREE) -> Product Array -> Instructional Grid (left to right).
whyItWins: The clear, illustrative, and segmented layout effectively communicates the product, its benefits, and a compelling offer through a logical visual flow, making complex information digestible.
